description: Mission Impawssible 🚀 We're a friendly team tackling the NASA Space Apps Challenge -Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars. We have skills in design, animation, graphic design, storytelling and are looking for developers. Join us to collaborate, learn, and build something awesome! Beginners welcome. Let's make the impossible possible!
summary:
Our project is an interactive storytelling experience designed for children to explore NASA's Spirit and Opportunity rover missions on Mars. Through a five-chapter adventure, children follow the journeys of the two rovers, discover the Martian environment, and learn about their scientific discoveries and challenges.

Each chapter includes interactive activities that allow children to participate in the story rather than simply read it. By combining storytelling, exploration, and interaction, we turn real NASA mission information into an engaging learning experience.

Our project addresses the challenge by bringing the stories of these abandoned rovers to life and sharing their contributions in a child-friendly way. It is important because it makes space science easier to understand, encourages curiosity, and inspires young learners to explore Mars and future space missions.
details:
Project Overview

Our project is an interactive storytelling experience for children that explores NASA's Spirit and Opportunity rover missions on Mars. Through a five-chapter adventure, children follow the rovers' journeys, discover the Martian environment, and learn about their discoveries and challenges.

How It Works

Each chapter includes interactive activities that let children participate in the story rather than simply read it. By combining storytelling, exploration, and interaction, we turn real NASA mission information into an engaging learning experience.

Benefits and Impact

The project makes space science easier for children to understand, encourages curiosity, and inspires young learners to explore Mars and future space missions. It brings the stories of these abandoned rovers to life and shares their contributions in a child-friendly way.

Tools and Technologies

We developed the project using Genially, which allowed us to build interactive slides with clickable elements, animations, and embedded activities that bring the story to life.

Creativity and Considerations

Instead of a textbook format, we turn real NASA history into an adventure story where children experience the mission firsthand. Our team considered age-appropriate content, engagement, emotional connection to the rovers' legacy, and accessibility across devices.
